intro: The fundraising pack, for charities and foundations: donors and what they give, campaigns against their goal, grants from application to final report, money that may only be spent on what it was given for, and tax receipts. With the pack on, a customer is called a donor. Switch it on in Organisation › Settings › Industry packs.
start: Turn the fundraising pack on in Organisation › Settings › Industry packs.
Check your receipt wording, registration number and signatory in the fundraising settings, so tax receipts read correctly.
Add your donors, starting from customers you already have.
Make a campaign with its goal and budget lines, then record gifts against it.
